notes: stores cost by group (ST_STORE_GRP.fmx, a query screen): transaction stores allowed for the user group x the groups of their items ((SELECT DISTINCT STORE_CODE, GROUP_CODE FROM ST_STORE_ITEM), group permission) with the total cost of the group in the store (sum of the item costs)

proc.description_a: تكلفة المخازن على مستوى المجموعات: يعرض الجدول لكل مخزن حركات مجموعات أصنافه والتكلفة الكلية لكل مجموعة. يمكن تحديد مخزن ثم الضغط على عرض؛ مجموع عمود التكلفة هو إجمالى التكلفة.
proc.description_e: Stores cost by group: the table lists, for each transaction store, the groups of its items with the total cost of each group. Choose a store (optional) and press Show; the sum of the cost column is the grand total.

params.name: STORE_CODE
params.lov_sql: select s.store_code || ' - ' || decode(:G_LANG, 'en', nvl(s.name_e, s.name_a), s.name_a) d, s.store_code r from st_store s where s.store_status = 1 and app_rules3_st.store_allowed(s.store_code) = 1 order by s.store_code

proc.preview_sql: select sg.store_code, decode(:G_LANG, 'en', nvl(s.name_e, s.name_a), s.name_a) store_name, sg.group_code, decode(:G_LANG, 'en', nvl(g.name_e, g.name_a), g.name_a) group_name, app_rules3_st.store_group_cost(sg.store_code, sg.group_code) total_cost from (select distinct store_code, group_code from st_store_item) sg, st_store s, st_item_group g where s.store_code = sg.store_code and g.item_group_code = sg.group_code and s.store_status = 1 and app_rules3_st.store_allowed(sg.store_code) = 1 and app_rules3_st.group_allowed(sg.group_code) = 1 and (v('P' || :APP_PAGE_ID || '_STORE_CODE') is null or sg.store_code = to_number(v('P' || :APP_PAGE_ID || '_STORE_CODE'))) order by sg.store_code, sg.group_code
